_readme: Claude Code settings for the seo-weekly MODEL job only (passed via claude-code-action `settings`). The model job holds a read-only GitHub token and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, nothing else. These deny rules keep it from writing anything it could later cause to execute (tests, scripts, configs, the toolkit, workflows, git internals). Anything it may write is re-checked by seo/scripts/verify-static.ts before a PR exists. Deny beats allow in Claude Code, so the allow-list lives in --allowedTools. Read denies name secret locations only: the checkout itself lives under the runner's home directory (~/work/<repo>/<repo>), so a blanket Read(~/**) would deny every page the model must read (and Edit needs a prior Read). .git/** is denied because the action may write a token into the remote URL; RUNNER_TEMP (~/work/_temp) holds the step command files and the execution log.
